doc: The cases to dump, the commit that wrote each version, and the verdict this build
must get on each fixture. See AGENTS.md before adding a case or a version.
Each case's source is `cases/<name>.py`. The values it must restore to are
recorded by the writing build in v<N>/manifest.json, not here.
`verdicts` may only name `loads` or `refused`; a `*` covers every version the

cases.name: plain
cases.doc: Scalar globals only, no heap containers.

cases.name: list
cases.doc: Heap containers, including nesting and a shared element.

cases.name: dict
cases.doc: Dicts and sets, whose entry layout the v10 tombstone work changes.

cases.name: strings
doc: Separates a clean refusal from silent corruption. `total` is a static
string, so its StringId indexes the static table; `xs` and `greeting_text`
are interned dynamically and index the dump's own table. An edit to the
middle of the static table renames the first and not the others.

cases.name: function
cases.doc: Compiled bytecode and frame locals, which the v6 renumbering changed.

cases.name: closure
cases.doc: A captured cell, kept live by the returned function.

cases.name: class
cases.doc: Instance identity, which the v8 bump changed.

cases.name: nested
cases.doc: Mixed containers several levels deep, plus a tuple key.
